conditions.name: Evidence actually available for the use
conditions.application: Match the proposed task and claim to actual releasable material, preserving role, country/remit, period, evidence object and limits. A reading path cannot create an absent case or make one setting apply to another.
conditions.boundary: Keep a narrowly useful interpretation or an honest gap where appropriate. No extra case quotas, named-case requirement, mandatory countries or removal of eligible aggregate contributions.

conditions.name: Edition, evidence, service and change reason
conditions.application: Separate the edition/publication date, evidence period and later briefing date. Distinguish correction of a mistake/scope defect, later-data/method refresh and a new task.
conditions.boundary: The existing contract’s correction/defect remedies remain included; no automatic extra fee, expiry, refresh cadence or future support promise. ONS is a method analogy only.

conditions.name: Briefing work boundary
conditions.application: Define whether the briefing interprets the existing edition or needs new evidence, analysis or client-specific research. Tailoring explanation remains possible, but a request is not a formatting change merely because it is short.
conditions.boundary: Narrow the answer, retain the unknown or agree genuine new work through the actual scope process. No unilateral charge or current-project expansion.

conditions.name: Incremental benefit and fulfilment basis
conditions.application: Specify what acknowledgement, briefing, excerpt/use asset or optional follow-through is delivered and what extra job it helps. Existing expert/event follow-through formats mean format alone is not a unique benefit.
conditions.boundary: A delivered placement/service is different from reach, interest, commercial response or useful impact. No need to be unique; actual relevance/value must be explored without invented outcomes.

conditions.name: Exact concept, asset stage and feedback
conditions.application: Use wording that fits the actual edition/funding purpose and record the relevant version shown. Separate an unaided need, feature reaction, conditional proposal request and actual agreement.
conditions.boundary: An unshown variant is unknown, not refused or validated. These are contextual distinctions, not an ordered funnel, conversion forecast or added participant form.

proposition_refinements.refinement: Use the actual edition/releasable evidence for the stated task; a briefing can interpret but cannot invent missing geography, case detail or findings. Show evidence/service dates and distinguish included corrections from later/new work.

Name the actual edition and supported work, including existing commissioned/completed research. Define fulfilment of briefing/recognition/use separately from reach or sales. Use the stage-appropriate concept rather than implying a new study.

Preserve free full research and optional follow-through. Any note/peer output must use permitted evidence with its actual dates; usefulness comes from relevant substance, not the note format or hospitality alone.

review_basis: 08-qa/T02-second-check-independent-review.md;1011independent integrated checks and199rootchecks across8constructed applications. No original buyer/practitioner validation or final publication approval.
